profile.headline: Software Engineer at Space Dynamics Laboratory

positions.title: Assistant Web Developer
positions.description: As a Web Developer Assistant, I have the opportunity to work on company wide utility applications, network with other students, integrate my knowledge and skills into the company through a Student Scholar Project, which was a CSS Framework based off of Material Design standards.

positions.title: Front End Developer, Intern
positions.description: During this internship, I gained a deeper understanding of the AGILE process, React, Node, and JavaScript overall. I was required to meet deadlines, communicate with team members, and work with other teams.

positions.title: CS 1 Lab Section Leader/Teaching Assistant
positions.description: As a CS 1 Lab Section Leader/Teaching Assistant, I would recap information given from CS 1 classes, plan lessons twice a week throughout the semester, have a reasonable understanding of C++, and communicate with other TA's. I would also answer students' questions and was a tutor once a week to help students better understand their assigned tasks.

positions.title: Front End Developer and Tester
positions.description: My responsibilities included being head of manual testing on some projects and React Web Development. I was expected to communicate with team members, manage tasks, and learn quickly.

positions.title: Customer Solutions Associate
positions.description: Key responsibilities included technical support with working the site, troubleshooting browser issues, sales, and answering questions regarding the products.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description: Responsibilities included: preparing product from beginning until completion, working with customers to ensure customer satisfaction as well as handling sales.

honors.title: 2nd Place State Winner for Accounting
honors.description: Placed 2rd in Utah State DECA competition leading to qualification for DECA's ICDC (Nationals/International competition) in Accounting Applications.

honors.title: 1st Place Regional Winner for Accounting (FBLA)
honors.description: Placed 1st in the Central Utah District for FBLA.
honors.issuer: Issued by Future Business Leaders of America · Feb 2014
